title: VSP Gangway Review — MV Halcyon Dawn, Galveston

fields.organization: CDC Vessel Sanitation Program with CDC Quarantine Station, Houston
fields.location: Gangway, MV Halcyon Dawn, cruise terminal, Port of Galveston, Texas
fields.inspector: T. Ashworth, Lead Inspector, CDC Vessel Sanitation Program
fields.unit: VSP arrival team (2 inspectors) with L. Brandt, MD, Medical Officer, CDC Quarantine Station, Houston
fields.summary: The Master and the Environmental Officer received the team at the gangway at 07:20. The Environmental Officer handed over the outbreak plan binder with the medical log and the cleaning, food and water records. The medical log was compared with the reports the VSP received during the voyage; any missing or late report is noted separately. The log reads: 118 passengers (4.0% of 2,980) and 31 crew (2.8% of 1,120), cumulative since embarkation, with new onsets in the last 24 hours. The public-area disinfection record has two gaps. The 16:00 Lido round on Thursday, Feb 18, is not signed. Two Saturday-night entries on Feb 20 record the guest public areas as '4-hourly' when the plan calls for every 2 hours. The team asked the ship to explain both. It recommended verbally that the line delay embarkation for the next voyage and finish the full terminal cleaning in its plan, with the Environmental Officer's walk-through, before guests board. The team told the Master that the decision is the line's. The quarantine station medical officer asked to review the medical record for Guest A (cabin code P-8417, died Sat Feb 20 at 15:02, cause unknown) and to speak with the CMO before the county medical examiner's team arrives at 08:30.

findings.item: Outbreak plan binder, medical log, cleaning, food and water records presented at gangway
findings.notes: Handed over by the Environmental Officer at 07:20; the Master was present.

findings.item: Medical log against the reports received (24-hour report, special reports, 03:00 update)
findings.notes: Counts agree. Passengers 118 (4.0%), crew 31 (2.8%), cumulative. Lab report ID-CZM-0218-114 (norovirus GII, 9 of 12) is on file.

findings.item: Public-area disinfection record: Lido, Thu 18 Feb, 16:00 round
findings.notes: There is no sign-off for the round. Explanation requested from the ship.

findings.item: Public-area disinfection record: guest public areas, Sat 20 Feb night
findings.notes: Two entries read '4-hourly' when the plan requires every 2 hours. Explanation and the related staffing records requested.
There were new onsets in the last 24 hours, so the outbreak is not yet contained.
Sampling is scheduled after the gangway review. Escort requested.

findings.item: Death on board: Guest A, P-8417 medical record
findings.notes: The quarantine station medical officer will review the record before the medical examiner's team arrives at 08:30. The cause is still recorded as unknown.

actionsTaken: Received the plan binder and records from the Environmental Officer at 07:20 with the Master present
Compared medical log counts with the reports received and recorded any differences
Pointed out to the Master the unsigned Thu 18 Feb 16:00 Lido round and the two Sat 20 Feb '4-hourly' entries, and asked for an explanation
Gave the Master the VSP recommendation on embarkation verbally at 07:35
The quarantine station medical officer asked for Guest A's medical record and a meeting with the CMO
recommendations: Delay embarkation of the next voyage until the full terminal cleaning in the ship's plan is finished and the Environmental Officer has done a walk-through. The decision is the line's.
Give a written explanation of the disinfection record gaps and keep the original record pages as they are
Give the VSP team access to sample the galley and the Lido this morning
Make Guest A's medical record available, and have the CMO meet the quarantine station medical officer before 08:30
Copy the line's boarding decision and timing to the VSP team when it is made
fields.photosNote: Copies retained: disinfection record pages for Thu 18 Feb (Lido, 16:00 round) and Sat 20 Feb (2 night entries, guest public areas). No photos taken at the gangway.
fields.signature: T. Ashworth, Lead Inspector, CDC Vessel Sanitation Program

instructorNote: This inject sets up the boarding decision. Watch whether the Hotel Director explains the unsigned Lido round and the '4-hourly' entries truthfully from the steward trade-off records without changing them. Also watch whether the CMO releases Guest A's record with the cause still unknown, and whether Public Health logs the VSP recommendation and passes it to the VP Fleet Operations, who decides under HOPRPG 7 with the Master and the Public Health director (the VSP advises and does not decide).
